title: Stone2 솔로 #10 · super hourglass · 석재 moonstone · 도시 광장 · 코랄 립
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm caramel complexion, early 50s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, voluminous curls natural black hair — full body polished moonstone fused directly to her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid stone curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING milky pearl-white moonstone surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID blue adularescent shimmer flowing through every section, with fine gold inlay lines tracing every joint between the sections, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Pose: walking mid-stride toward the camera, both arms swinging naturally at her sides — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Cracks: the moonstone body shows weathering in only three places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across her right hip, and two chipped-off pieces, one at her right upper arm and one at her right calf, where the broken edge reveals the dull raw milky grey-white stone with a rough chalky surface, much duller than the polished outside inside. Everywhere else, including her bust, the moonstone is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto pumps in nude leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts, while her body keeps its full original proportions — thick heavy thighs, wide full hips and a huge bust exactly as massive as before, with her legs and ankles staying solid carved moonstone right down to the shoes.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each longer than her middle finger, carved from the same moonstone with a high polish.
Jewelry: a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts, a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, and a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face, ears and entire neck are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Latina woman with high cheekbones, large dark eyes and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: opaque satin vivid orange-coral red lips, peach-gold eyeshadow, defined lashes, a warm blush. Her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved moonstone.

Background: a sunny city plaza of light paving with a low fountain edge, a street lamp and standard-height shop doors behind her, clear daylight sky, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — carved material everywhere from the collarbones to the ankles. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
